name: Golem, Gearshift
body:
Gearshift Golem CR 8

XP 4,800
N Large construct
Init –1; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 25, touch 8, flat-footed 25 (–1 Dex, +17 natural, –1 size)
hp 90 (11d10+30)
Fort +4, Ref +3, Will +4
DR 10/bludgeoning; Immune construct traits, magic

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee 2 slams +21 (2d8+8)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 27; Dex 9, Con —, Int —; Wis 11; Cha 1
Base Atk +13; CMB +23; CMD 32

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Immunity to Magic (Ex)

A gearshift golem is immune to any spell or spell-like ability that allows spell resistance. In addition, certain spells and effects function differently against the creature, as noted below.

A shatter spell causes a gearshift golem 4d10 damage.

A transmute metal to wood spell causes a gearshift golem 6d10 damage.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary or gang (2–4)
Treasure none

A gearshift golem has a humanoid-style chassis made from metal that houses a watchwork assembly of mechanical parts. Like most golems, a gearshift golem cannot speak and makes whirring and clicking sounds when it moves. A gearshift golem is 8 feet tall and weighs around 1,600 pounds. The gearshift golem’s heart is made from a large emerald. The emerald must be of exceptional quality, with a value of at least 3,000 gp.

Crafting this Golem

CL 11th; Price 52,000 gp

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Construct, Spells animate object, geas/quest, imbue with aura, Special creator must be caster level 11th; Skill Checks Craft (mechanical devices) or Craft (blacksmithing) DC 18; Cost 29,000 gp
